summary: Trust Wallet launched in-wallet Pokémon and collectible packs powered by Collector Crypt, and Binance Wallet launched Renaiss Gacha the same night. So the in-wallet packs idea is now on two very big wallets, not just Solflare and Jupiter. Courtyard had a strong day too: a $10,000 pack hit a Pikachu that was sold back 13 seconds later, and one post says Courtyard was 45% of OpenSea's top-30 volume. Solflare Packs talk was busy but almost all of it was ambassador-style explainers, and a few used "$100 into $250" style framing we should not echo.
